verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published benchmarks, latency figures, or recall measurements from Pinecone. The console's 'Monitor performance' feature is an adjacent monitoring tool, not published numbers backing performance claims. Community comments mention benchmarks only in general terms, not as Pinecone-published data.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see published benchmarks or measured latency/recall numbers backing the database's performance claims
